popCulture.title: Phoenix (son of Agenor)
popCulture.description: Son of Agenor and Telephassa, brother of Cadmus and Europa — the eponym who gives his name to Phoenicia; carefully distinct from Phoenix son of Amyntor, Achilles' tutor.

popCulture.title: Phoenicia
popCulture.description: The Levantine coast named for Phoenix in Greek ethnography — the brother's search for Europa fossilized as a place-name.

popCulture.title: Agenor
popCulture.description: Phoenix's father — the king who sends his sons to find Europa and thereby seeds Cadmus' Thebes and Phoenicia's name.

popCulture.title: Europa
popCulture.description: Phoenix's sister — the princess Zeus carries to Crete; her brothers' failed search becomes the foundation myth of Phoenicia and Thebes.
